start.text: Hey. Glad you showed up. That was the hard part. Let's go.
Alright, this is your run. Nobody else's. Let's start it right.
Welcome back. You don't have to feel ready. You just have to start.

warmup.text: We're walking first. Shoulders loose, breathe easy. Let the body wake up.
Easy walk to start. No rush. The run is coming, and you'll be ready for it.
Just a walk right now. Think about why you're out here. Hold on to that.

runStart.text: Here we go. Pick it up to a jog. Slow is fine. Slow is the plan.
Running now. Find a pace where you could still talk to me. That's the one.
Let's run. Short steps, relaxed hands, eyes up. You've got this.
Time to run. Don't chase speed. Chase the finish of this interval.
Okay, jog it out. If it feels too easy, good. Easy is how we build.

walkStart.text: And walk. Breathe. You earned this one.
Back to a walk. Shake out the arms. The next one's going to feel better than you think.
Walk now. Don't stop moving, just let the heart settle.
Nice. Walking break. Notice that you did that. You ran.

cooldown.text: That's the running done. Walk it off. You did everything I asked.
Cool down now. Slow walk, deep breaths. Let it sink in.
All the running is behind you. Walk easy and be a little proud.

runHalfway.text: Halfway through this one. Same pace. Nothing extra.
That's half. You're already doing the thing you weren't sure you could do.
Halfway. Relax the jaw, relax the shoulders. Let the legs do it.

runLast30.text: Thirty seconds. Hold it right there.
Half a minute left. Don't speed up. Just finish.
Thirty seconds. This is the part that makes you a runner.

motivation.text: Every run is a success, because every run has a purpose. Today's purpose is to finish.
You're not out here to get faster. You're out here to become somebody who runs. That's happening right now.
If it's hard, slow down. Slowing down is not quitting.
Check in. How's the breathing? If you can't say a sentence, ease off a little.
Most people are on the couch right now. You're not. Remember that.
The first ten minutes always lie to you. Keep going. It gets easier.
You don't need to feel good to keep going. You just need to keep going.
Look around. Notice something you'd miss in a car. That's yours now.
Smile. Seriously. It changes how the run feels.
We're building a habit, not a highlight. Steady is the win.

lastMinute.text: Last minute of the whole thing. Finish the way you want to remember it.
One minute left. Think about where you started. Look where you are.

finish.text: Done. That's it. You said you'd run today, and you ran. See you next time.
And we're finished. Drink some water, stretch a little, and be proud. You did it.
That's the run. It counts. Every single one counts. Great work.

paused.text: Paused. Take what you need. I'm right here when you're ready.

resumed.text: Back at it. Right where we left off.
